orders: A fixed repair can improve an intelligent system without the repair itself having intelligence.
Preserving a person's capability and diagnosing a machine fault concern different targets.
A retained ability can exist without a learning event taking place now.
A modifier can qualify membership or change the target
Elaborating an improvement method may make the method worse; improving development requires a different success argument.
An art review is text about art; a sculpture of handwritten marks is an artwork about writing.
Same denotation under the stated qualifier convention
The same engineering manual satisfies both labels; the reordered label changes indexing, not membership.
Different words and roles, not a pure permutation
A poetry revision method is a writing technique while the poem need not have a technical subject.
Question and intended result change places
The question 'Which destination?' differs from its goal of resolving a destination.
A stored candidate set persists while no search is being executed.
A binary-search prescription differs from looking for a suitable search procedure.
Assessing forecast accuracy differs from guessing a fabric's quality.
A class can itself be studied without settling where an unrelated subject belongs.
Truth[target=the assertion made by assessment A]
Verdict versus whether the verdict holds
A false assessment remains an assessment; its truth is absent.
Writing an explanation is an event; the account can persist after writing ends.
An automatic grader can be evaluated manually.
Preserving a gain versus improving its preservation
Holding an achieved performance level steady is not itself an increase over that level.
Nested scope: improve preservation versus preserve gains
Improving a retention regimen differs from continuing a regimen that preserves a previous gain.
Nested scope: change a capability versus specify a needed capability
Training better fault diagnosis differs from possessing the reasoning required to redesign maintenance.
Nested scope: preserve a capability versus specify a needed capability
Keeping an optimizer capable differs from the capability needed to keep a past gain from eroding.
Same word order, different hidden relation
Improving preservation of a cognitive capability differs from improving smart maintenance of a bridge.
Intelligence[whose measured level is not improving]
Complement of a qualified change class
A change to a chair is not an intelligence improvement; it is not thereby non-improving intelligence.
Attachment of one qualifier changes whose property it is
An adult art-history essay about children's drawings satisfies the second but need not suit child readers.
A failed training project can retain a coherent improvement goal without achieving the change.
qualification_tests: Complete the relation as well as the words
Intelligence improvement
Improvement[target=intelligent capability,criterion=C,baseline=B]
The phrase selects a change in capability as the item being classified.
Adding the topic Intelligence does not make the change an instance of the capability.
A narrow inclusion can hold despite a broad refutation
Development is not universally Improvement
Development[also improves intelligence under C] ⊆ Development and Improvement
A worsening development refutes the broad universal but says nothing against the beneficial subclass.
Never inherit a broad separating counterexample into a subclass unless the counterexample satisfies the qualifier.
Universal inclusion passes to a subclass
Every Improvement is Change
Improvement[target=intelligence] ⊆ Change
All instances of the qualified class retain the defining improvement conditions.
A qualification must retain the same head meaning for this inheritance to apply.
Disjointness passes to a subclass
Capability and Change are disjoint in the fixed senses
Improvement[target=intelligence] is disjoint from Capability in those senses
Every instance is a change; the inherited disjointness applies to that item.
This uses an explicit sense rule, not the weaker claim that some changes are not capabilities.
Topic does not become genus automatically
Writing[topic=art]
The writing belongs under Writing; the topic remains Art.
An art review and a nontextual artwork have different produced forms.
A subject index can group both under Art without proving that they are the same kind.
A whole family needs a declared union
Intelligence: improvement and maintenance
The two activities can be gathered as a family of work concerning intelligence.
The family contains specified activities concerning the capability.
This does not establish that every instance of intelligence is an improving or maintaining activity.
Modifier restrictions need not partition a parent
Writing[technical topic] and Writing[art topic]
The two can overlap in a conservation-engineering manual.
A single text can satisfy both topic predicates.
Additional words do not guarantee exclusive sibling categories; define a separating criterion or retain overlapping views.
More detail can make an empty type
Capability ∩ Change under the fixed disjointness rule
No item satisfies both primary senses in this model.
The conjunction conflicts with an admitted exclusion.
A nonempty example or a revised sense is needed before this can serve as a substantive category.
Reordering can be an alias
Technical writing and Writing technical
Both denote Writing[domain=technical] when this reading is fixed.
One membership test decides both labels.
Use one expression identity with two display orders; do not create duplicate subjects.
Same order can hide different relations
Intelligence maintenance improvement
Improvement of maintenance OF intelligence or maintenance USING intelligence.
Identical token order can denote different targets.
Relations such as target, means, product, audience, and standard must be recorded.
Negation must retain its scope
Not an improvement of intelligence
It can be a change outside that class, an unsuccessful attempt, or a separate denial depending on the chosen universe.
A complement of a qualified class is not simply a negated target.
State the universe and whether the negation applies to the operation, target, success condition, or whole claim.
Success is a membership condition when named
Improvement attempt versus achieved improvement
An attempt is a process seeking benefit; achieved improvement requires an actual beneficial change.
A failed attempt supplies the separation.
A project that aims to improve intelligence has not thereby become an achieved improvement.
Completion is relative to the question being settled
Artifact versus Intelligence improvement under C
A short term can already have adequate membership conditions; a long expression can remain ambiguous.
Length is not the measure of completeness.
Stop adding qualifiers when remaining alternatives do not change the live type claim or required action.
Changing the question can change the classified unit
Art: what exists? Art: how is it made? Art: why does it matter?
An artwork, creation process, and evaluation are distinct referents in the same topic family.
A family index is broader than the denotation of any one row.
Keep the referent and the matter to settle alongside the short subject name.
Subtype and usefulness are independent
A method for intelligence improvement
It is a Method by its prescription form; whether it improves a specified capability is a further claim.
A formally complete method can fail in use.
Project classifications must preserve their intended task and evidence of effects separately.
Qualification exposes new missing subjects
Improve the way intelligence improvement is measured
Improvement[target=Evaluation[target=intelligence]]
The improvement target is the assessment process, not necessarily intelligence itself.
An apparent higher score can come from changing assessment; that does not establish an improved capability.
wording_changes: Universalization operates on N-valued type theory; asks what this is an instance of.
Universalization asks what this is an instance of and explores the possibility space.
The type-enumeration programme predates the compressed essay. The explicit type-theory label and associated rationale were removed; the instance-of operation survived.
Type framework wording removed; operation partly retained
Super-intelligence, form? System super-intelligent, mean? How answer? Define intelligence. Define learning.
An introductory promise to demonstrate better definitions.
The earlier form exposes separate unresolved questions and definition operations; the rewrite turns them into an introduction.
Learning is perception and action. Improving is perception and action.
Learning is about perception and action; improving is also about them.
The relation changes from an identity-like assertion to aboutness. The second does not preserve the first claim's consequences.
How evaluate claim hard? Some claim hard. Other claim not.
How evaluate claim hard? Some claims are hard, and other claims are not.
The initial head-first phrase remains. The prose expands the same contrast in ordinary word order.
Contrast largely preserved; compressed form partly retained
Hard claim many presupposition. Non hard claim little presupposition.
Hard claims contain many presuppositions, while less hard claims contain fewer.
The old contrast uses adjacent slots for claim, difficulty, and presupposition count. The new version supplies the containment relation explicitly.
Useful structural repetition expanded with an explicit relation
Reason = guess method. Analogy = guess method. Expection = guess method.
Reason = guess method. Analogy = guess method. Expectation = guess method.
A shared parent expression is kept visible for several candidate members. Both versions preserve the repeated classification form.
Guessing quality improve any way improve action, reasoning, writing, planning, prediction, decisions.
Improving guessing quality improves action, reasoning, writing, planning, prediction, and decision-making.
The target-quality-change sequence becomes ordinary verbal prose. Its structural roles can be recovered without claiming the cross-domain improvement is established.
Order changes; broad causal claim remains an authored claim
Reasonable inference is a form of guessing; consciousness can be thought of through continuous guessing and its improvement.
An identity chain is replaced by classification and a proposed interpretation. These have different logical consequences.
Identity weakened and split into different relationships
Search can = Exploration, can = Testing, cannot = anything else.
In this framing, search is either exploration or testing.
The exhaustive division is explicitly bounded to a framing in the later wording.
Search space optimization quality = intelligence level.
Search space optimization quality tracks intelligence level.
Identity and association allow different inferences. This is an example where making a sentence smoother also changes its proposition.
The relational shorthand remains in the current text. Its presence documents the approach; it does not supply a formal vector-space account.
Question no presuppositions explicit, non hidden, obvious.
Questions make those presuppositions more explicit, less hidden, and more obvious.
The earlier string admits competing parses. The later wording selects a comparative-explicitness interpretation; it is not proof of the original intended parse.
An ambiguous expression receives a selected interpretation
After defining categories and relationships, the author switches to standard communication.
After defining categories and relationships, the author says standard communication can preserve meaning.
Both versions explicitly distinguish structural preparation from ordinary presentation. This supports the user's account of deliberate form selection.
Intelligence is this cycle done well.
Learning is this cycle getting better over time.
The same explore/find/test/act cycle is qualified by current performance and by change over time. It is an earlier explicit example of classifying different aspects of a shared process.
Earlier qualification pattern; not a later wording change
A rigorous setup creating universally working structures and greater certainty.
A system making assumptions, alternatives, tests, uncertainty, and next actions harder to skip.
The later revision narrows the stated ambition and changes the proposed success conditions. It is a substantive edit separate from typography or grammar.
source_note: Excerpts are brief; some before/after cells paraphrase whole passages. Analytical consequences are current interpretations, not claims that the historical essay proves its substantive theses. Exact source URLs identify both revisions.
